text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During lunch break. When I arrived at the 
table Forever Young called me to, someone 
was already there.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Remember those prototype concept goods for 
everyday use I showed you guys before? I'm 
hosting an unveiling party next time, so 
totally come by♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
For real? Count me in~! Where are you 
holding it?

text_block_list.name: Japanese Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"Welcome to Los Angeles, everyone from 
Japan!"

text_block_list.name: Japanese Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"Through various exhibits and hands-on 
experiences, this event brings together 
people, technology, and ideas to pioneer 
new possibilities in racing—"

text_block_list.name: Attendee A
text_block_list.text:
Daddy! They have a fashion show with 
racing silks from all different countries! 
Let's go see it~!

text_block_list.name: Attendee B
text_block_list.text:
Your company's reputation has reached 
across borders, and we have long wished to 
speak with you. On such an occasion, we 
would be honored—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"RACING WORLD EXPO"... Wait, what the heck 
is this?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the pamphlet, it's like... a 
global festival gathering racing-related 
businesses from all over the world? And 
Young-ko's got a booth here too, right?
choice_data_list:
This scale is completely out of this 
world...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, Jordan-san and City-san, and even 
you!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, Jordan-san and City-san, and even 
you!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"What a coincidence~! Were you all invited 
by Young-ko-san too?"
choice_data_list:
Yeah, though I never imagined it'd be an 
overseas Expo...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
This Expo is such a wonderful event, isn't 
it... You can feel the love for racing 
flowing through the entire venue♡

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for coming! Just kidding♪ Is 
everyone having fun?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Man, since it's the very first one, the 
attention is insane♪ Totally worth 
proposing this whole Expo idea!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
The Expo's host is my dad's company♪ And 
the mastermind behind it was M-E!

text_block_list.name: Young's Father
text_block_list.text:
Young, it's almost time for the main 
event.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Oh, shoot, you're right. Guess I'll head 
out and put on the finishing touch!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Yep, running an exhibition race♪ Against 
the big-name horse girls who call this 
place their home turf!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Paint the world in my colors—and set it 
ablaze with hype. It all starts right 
here♪

text_block_list.name: Attendee D
text_block_list.text:
She thinks they'll win? On U.S. Dirt? 
(Does she really think she can win? On 
American dirt?)

text_block_list.name: Attendee E
text_block_list.text:
They don't stand a chance against the 
local powerhouses. (Taking on the local 
powerhouses is just reckless.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A natural reaction. The name "Forever 
Young" had not yet reached foreign ears. 
And yet—
choice_data_list:
If it's her, she can trigger a true 
innovation!

(She must have mapped out a route to 
victory already.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
That's right♡ My big sister always said 
that once Young-ko-san sets her mind on 
something, she will definitely make it 
happen♪

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Do your best—! Love-chan and I are right 
behind you!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—Clang!)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
For real. It's an insane race, but I 
honestly can't picture Young-ko losing at 
all.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, Young-ko's definitely gonna pull 
it off! Hasn't she always delivered up 
till now?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—Clang!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking back, the "prep work" she 
mentioned during our overseas tour must 
have been negotiations regarding the Expo 
exhibition and this very race. If so—
choice_data_list:
(She must have calculated a surefire way 
to win!)

text_block_list.name: Young's Father
text_block_list.text:
—Once that girl believes she "can do it," 
she's unstoppable. Once she sets a goal, 
she takes the shortest path and seizes 
results without fail.

text_block_list.name: Young's Father
text_block_list.text:
Young... Today, will you show the entire 
world what you're made of?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—Clang!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking back, the "prep work" she 
mentioned during our overseas tour must 
have been negotiations regarding the Expo 
exhibition and this very race. If so—
choice_data_list:
(She must have calculated a surefire way 
to win!)

text_block_list.name: Young's Father
text_block_list.text:
—The world's wall is high. But up until 
today, Young has done everything solely to 
win.

text_block_list.name: Young's Father
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is to believe. That my 
beloved child will answer those 
expectations—with the strength capable of 
achieving it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—Clang!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She displayed a performance so commanding 
you wouldn't believe it was an away match— 
Yet the overseas horse girls had their 
home-turf pride. Exhibiting their power 
from early on, they had no intention of 
relinquishing the lead.
choice_data_list:
As expected, horse girls raised on 
authentic dirt are tough...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, Forever Young was not about to 
back down. As if demonstrating the future 
she herself would pioneer, she closed the 
gap with relentless drive.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
The winner of this memorable race was. 
(Claiming victory in this memorable race 
is—)

text_block_list.name: Overseas Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Care to try a U.S.- based training plan? 
(Would you be interested in training in 
America?)

text_block_list.name: Overseas Company CEO
text_block_list.text:
A runner like you would make for a great 
business partner! (Let us discuss becoming 
business partners in racing!)

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
I'm really flattered by the offers, but 
first. (I'll listen to all your offers. 
But first,)

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
With my roadmap— I'm bringing true 
innovation to the racing world!
